claim: Zenodo is an external multidisciplinary open research repository hosted by CERN/OpenAIRE for preserving and sharing publications, data, software, and other research outputs.
future_grounding_route: Zenodo records can become acquisition candidates only after file manifests, licenses, hashes, and biological metadata are inspected by project intake scripts.
project_use: Supplementary-data and processed-data discovery route for MS studies.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: General research outputs, supplementary datasets, software, and DOI-backed archives not indexed in specialist bioinformatics repositories.
why_unverifiable: Zenodo records are externally deposited and heterogeneous; the project must inspect and ground any specific record before use.
